one_liner: Help Scout is a customer support platform that brings email, chat, voice, and help center resources into one workspace with AI-powered assistance and reporting.
auth_notes: Mailbox API uses OAuth 2.0 authorization, implementing Authorization Code and Client Credential flows. Docs API uses API keys passed via HTTP Basic Authentication in the username field with a dummy password.
verdict_reason: Help Scout provides documented REST APIs (Mailbox API and Docs API) supporting OAuth 2.0 and API key (Basic) authentication, which are publicly accessible to developers.

extras.rate_limit_note: Rate limits are based on the number of Docs Sites the account has (e.g. 2000 requests every 10 mins for 1 site).
